## 🌿 About

**Agro-Zenith** is a full-stack agricultural web platform designed to bridge the digital divide for Tamil Nadu farmers. It consolidates everything a farmer needs — from AI-powered crop disease detection and real-time market prices to government scheme discovery and GPS farm mapping — all in one accessible, multilingual interface.

This project evolved from earlier AgriTech initiatives (**KisanLens** → **AgriMind** → **Agro-Zenith**), culminating in a feature-rich platform that addresses real-world farming challenges in Tamil Nadu.

---

## ✨ Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| 🌿 **Crop Disease Detection** | AI-powered detection of crop diseases from uploaded images |
| 📈 **Market Prices** | Real-time crop and produce market price tracking |
| 🏛️ **Government Schemes** | Eligibility checker for agricultural schemes and subsidies |
| 🗺️ **Farm Mapping** | GPS-based farm boundary mapping using Leaflet |
| 🌦️ **Weather Updates** | Real-time weather data via Open-Meteo API |
| 🛒 **Farmer Marketplace** | Direct buy/sell platform for farmers |
| 🌐 **Multilingual** | Full support for English, Tamil, and Hindi |
| 💾 **Offline Persistence** | Data persisted locally via localStorage |

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

**Frontend:**
- [React](https://react.dev/) + [Vite](https://vitejs.dev/) — fast, modern UI framework
- Inline styles — no external CSS framework dependency
- [Leaflet.js](https://leafletjs.com/) — interactive GPS farm mapping

**APIs & Services:**
- [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/) — free, real-time weather data
- Custom crop disease detection model (AI/ML backend)

**Storage:**
- `localStorage` — client-side data persistence

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Prerequisites

Make sure you have the following installed:

- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) (v18 or above)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/) or [yarn](https://yarnpkg.com/)

### Installation

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/your-username/agro-zenith.git

# Navigate to the project directory
cd agro-zenith

# Install dependencies
npm install
```

### Running the App

```bash
# Start the development server
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:5173](http://localhost:5173) in your browser.

```bash
# Build for production
npm run build

# Preview production build
npm run preview
```

## 🔍 Features in Detail

### 🌿 Crop Disease Detection
Upload an image of your crop and the AI model will analyze it, identify potential diseases, and provide actionable recommendations for treatment.

### 📈 Market Prices
Live and historical market prices for a wide range of crops — helping farmers make informed decisions about when and where to sell.

### 🏛️ Government Schemes
An eligibility checker that filters government agricultural subsidies and schemes based on the farmer's profile, land size, and crop type.

### 🗺️ GPS Farm Mapping
Draw and save farm boundaries on an interactive map using Leaflet. Tracks farm size, location, and plots — all stored locally.

### 🌦️ Real-Time Weather
Fetches hyperlocal weather forecasts via Open-Meteo — temperature, humidity, rainfall probability, and wind speed — without any API key requirement.

### 🛒 Farmer Marketplace
A peer-to-peer marketplace where farmers can list produce for sale or browse listings from other farmers in Tamil Nadu.

---

## 🌐 Multilingual Support

Agro-Zenith supports three languages, switchable from the navigation bar:

| Language | Code |
|---|---|
| English | `en` |
| Tamil (தமிழ்) | `ta` |
| Hindi (हिन्दी) | `hi` |

All UI labels, messages, and content adapt dynamically based on the selected language.
